description: This file defines the LiquibaseProvider interface which provides access to Liquibase instances for database migrations within the OpenMRS project. It includes documentation on licensing, purpose, and interface method signature.

classes.name: LiquibaseProvider
classes.description: Interface that provides a method to obtain Liquibase instances for database changelogs.

methods.name: getLiquibase
methods.description: Returns a Liquibase instance given a changelog file name. It can throw an Exception.
